annotation.title_clean: LEGGE 27 dicembre 2017, n. 205. Bilancio di previsione dello Stato per l'anno finanziario 2018 e bilancio pluriennale per il triennio 2018-2020
annotation.title_en: Law 27 December 2017, No. 205. State Budget Forecast for Financial Year 2018 and Multi-Year Budget for 2018-2020
annotation.venue: Gazzetta Ufficiale della Repubblica Italiana, Supplemento ordinario n. 62/L, Serie generale n. 302
annotation.summary_en: Italy's 2018 Budget Law (Law 205/2017), a broad fiscal statute. Only tangential embodied-AI content: Industry 4.0 training tax credit covering advanced and collaborative robotics, and authorisation of on-road testing of Smart Road and connected/automated driving solutions with funding of one million euro per year for 2018-2019.
key_provisions_or_claims: Art.1 c.46-56: 40% tax credit for Industry 4.0 training, including advanced and collaborative robotics
Art.1 c.72: authorises road testing of Smart Road and connected and automated driving, with a ministerial decree on procedures
Art.1 c.72: spending of EUR 1 million per year for 2018 and 2019 for Smart Road testing
Art.1 c.29-35: super-depreciation for new capital goods and Industry 4.0 investments
Art.1 c.67-69: funding for Higher Technical Institutes aligned with Industry 4.0
